 Appearance :
 For the Appellant/s : Mr.Ugranath Mallik  For the Respondent/s : Mr.Abha Singh  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NAWNEET KUMAR  PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 5 09-07-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. The present appeal has been filed by the appellant against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 09.12.2024, passed by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Darbhanga in POCSO G.R.Case No. 06 of 2014, arising out of Mahila P.S.Case No. 59 of 2014, whereby the appellant was convicted under Sections 354B and 8 of the POCSO Act, and was sentenced to undergo RI for three years each and fine of Rs. 5,000/- each, and in default in payment whereof,
was directed to undergo SI for six months each.
All the sentences were directed to run concurrently.

3. The learned counsel for the appellant, while Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.377 of 2025(5)
dt.09-07-2025 making prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail, has submitted that the charges under Section 376 of the IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act were not proved and accordingly the appellant was acquitted under those Sections.
He was found guilty under Section 354B of the IPC and Section 8 of the POCSO Act.

The maximum sentence awarded to the appellant is three years RI with a fine of Rs. 5,000/- and the appellant has remained in custody for 17 months,
nearly half of the awarded sentence.

5. Considering the above facts and circumstances, and also keeping in view the fact that there is no likelihood of the appeal being taken up for hearing in the near future, during the pendency of the appeal, let the sentence of the appellant named above be suspended and he be released on bail on furnishing bail bond Rs. 10,000/ (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Darbhanga in POCSO G.R.Case No. 06 of 2014,
arising Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.377 of 2025(5) dt.09-07-2025 out of Mahila P.S.Case No.
6. The realization of fine shall remain stayed, during the pendency of this appeal.
